urgency_classes.LOW: Mild symptoms, stable disease, Grade 1 toxicity, or negative review of systems.
urgency_classes.MODERATE: Persistent symptoms, Grade 2 toxicity, dose modifications under evaluation.
urgency_classes.HIGH: Severe symptoms, Grade 3/4 toxicity, emergency triage, irAEs, or life-threatening events.

ner_bio_tags.B-GENE_MUTATION: Beginning token of a genomic alteration, mutation, or molecular biomarker.
ner_bio_tags.I-GENE_MUTATION: Inside token of a genomic alteration, mutation, or molecular biomarker.
ner_bio_tags.B-DRUG: Beginning token of an oncology pharmacological agent.
ner_bio_tags.I-DRUG: Inside token of an oncology pharmacological agent.
ner_bio_tags.B-DOSAGE: Beginning token of a clinical dose, concentration, or administration schedule.
ner_bio_tags.I-DOSAGE: Inside token of a clinical dose, concentration, or administration schedule.
ner_bio_tags.B-ADVERSE_EVENT: Beginning token of a treatment-related adverse effect or toxicity.
ner_bio_tags.I-ADVERSE_EVENT: Inside token of a treatment-related adverse effect or toxicity.
ner_bio_tags.O: Outside of any defined clinical entity.
